g.text: From account creation to the smallest meaningful stored field · proposal based on repository inspection
28 proposed Cascade tables = 15 core + 9 editor + 4 optional social. Clerk boxes are NOT additional Neon tables.
Do not equate attempt with session
Clerk account ID → users.id (external identity link, not a cross-database FK)
users 1 → N projects; users 1 → 0..1 user_preferences; users 1 → N user_platform_preferences
projects 1 → N media_assets; projects 1 → N jobs; jobs 1 → N child jobs; jobs 1 → N job_steps
jobs 1 → N clips; media_assets 1 → N source clips; clips 1 → N clip_outputs
clip_outputs → video asset + optional caption asset; projects N ↔ N clip_outputs via saved_clips
media_assets 1 → N transcripts 1 → N transcript_segments 1 → N transcript_words
projects 1 → N edit_drafts 1 → N timeline_tracks 1 → N timeline_items
timeline_items → media_assets; timeline_items 1 → N item_effects 1 → N effect_keyframes
caption_styles 1 → N caption_cues; timeline_tracks 1 → N caption_cues 1 → N caption_words
edit_drafts 1 → N exports; exports → render job + optional output asset
users 1 → N social_connections; social_posts 1 → N publications ← 1 social_connections
08 · STORAGE BOUNDARY: Neon = records / keys / metadata. Local or S3 = MP4, audio, VTT, thumbnails, caches.
Browser = transient UI state / authenticated session transport. Do not copy passwords, tokens or verification codes into Neon.
09 · LOGOUT ends a session; it does not delete projects. Account deletion needs an explicit cleanup / retention workflow.
Proposed provisioning: create Neon user on first verified request (idempotently) or verified webhook. Neither is claimed implemented.
Optional app login audit is NOT part of the 28-table count. Add auth_events only if product requirements need retained app history.
10 · STOP HERE: transcript word → text + start_ms + end_ms. Values are fields, not more tables. Pixels stay in files.
PK = primary key; multiple PK fields = composite key. FK = foreign key. ? = nullable. 1 → N permits zero or many children.
Each FK field above is a connection to draw. Verify all cross-project references belong to the authenticated owner.
Flexible JSONB fields are deliberate leaves in this proposal; expand their schemas when editing requirements are fixed.
CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION: cascade_app.records is one JSONB base table with four views. Legacy public tables are separate.
Clerk boxes describe responsibilities, not its internal database schema or enabled account configuration. Live state unverified.
Sources: DATABASE.md, migrations/001_metadata.sql, metadata_store.py, app1.py, integration.py, INTEGRATION.md. No migrations applied.
